name: third-party.context7
description: Curated provider manifest for the docs.latest capability.

docs.latest.fallback: Use official docs, vendored docs, package source or repository examples as evidence.

install.method: Install the upstream Context7 MCP or CLI/skills mode for the target agent.
uninstall: Remove the Context7 MCP/CLI configuration from the target agent and remove this provider plugin from the AgentRig install set.

permissions.approval: Human approval required before sending proprietary code, secrets or private project context to documentation lookup tools.

transport.notes: Use the upstream-supported transport for the target agent; this wrapper records capability and safety policy only.

security.notes: Context7 output is evidence, not final truth. Prefer explicit library IDs and versions.

risk.notes: External and community-contributed docs can be incomplete, stale or unsafe.
